2610.11617.title: TAM: Task-Aware Memory Distillation for Efficient Spatiotemporal Prediction
2610.11617.paper_summary: Knowledge distillation enables efficient spatiotemporal prediction by transferring knowledge from an accurate teacher to a compact student. However, matching outputs or features independently for each sample leaves cross-sample predictive structure underused. Exploiting this structure requires representations and historical references that reflect the dynamics of each task. We propose TAM, a Task-Aware Memory Distillation framework that organizes a frozen teacher's knowledge into a bounded, retrievable history. Memory entries encode latent features, forecast changes, or flow residuals, while task-specific selection rules identify relevant historical references. The student either matches the teacher's similarity distribution over shared references or regresses observation-conditioned residual prototypes. These objectives complement supervised prediction and conventional distillation. The teacher, memory, and auxiliary adapters are used only during training, leaving student inference unchanged. We evaluate TAM on video prediction, weather forecasting, and traffic flow prediction across multiple teacher-student configurations. Averaged over four paired runs, adding TAM improves SSIM on all six video datasets and reduces MSE on five relative to the corresponding KD baselines. Mean paired MSE reductions reach 1.86% on KittiCaltech, 1.93% on WeatherBench with a gSTA teacher, and 1.01% on TaxiBJ. These results demonstrate the utility of historical teacher supervision across distinct forecasting tasks without additional student inference cost.
2610.11617.paper_summary_zh: 知識蒸餾透過將準確的教師知識轉移到緊湊的學生上，使得空間時間預測變得高效。然而，對每個樣本獨立匹配輸出或特徵會使得跨樣本的預測結構未被充分利用。利用這一結構需要反映每個任務動態的表示和歷史參考。我們提出了TAM，一種任務感知記憶蒸餾框架，將凍結的教師知識組織成一個有界的、可檢索的歷史。記憶條目編碼潛在特徵、預測變化或流動殘差，而特定任務的選擇規則則識別相關的歷史參考。學生要麼匹配教師在共享參考上的相似性分佈，要麼回歸觀察條件下的殘差原型。這些目標補充了監督預測和傳統蒸餾。教師、記憶和輔助適配器僅在訓練期間使用，學生推理不變。我們在視頻預測、天氣預報和交通流預測中評估了TAM，涵蓋多個教師-學生配置。在四次配對運行的平均結果中，添加TAM提高了所有六個視頻數據集的SSIM，並在五個數據集上相對於相應的KD基準減少了MSE。KittiCaltech的平均配對MSE減少達到1.86%，WeatherBench在gSTA教師下達到1.93%，TaxiBJ則為1.01%。這些結果展示了在不同預測任務中歷史教師監督的效用，而不增加學生推理的成本。
